records.name: Venn Upwhere
records.biography_en: HyperNorm recruited Venn to maintain five points of visual contact. It now pays him to look away from four of them.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: All five witnesses were present. Unfortunately they shared a body.

records.name: Grom Portside
records.biography_en: Grom pilots the smallest saucer that can legally be called a HyperNorm vehicle. The regulation is measured from his waist.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: He arrived five minutes late and insisted the saucer had been early.

records.name: Nia Crossband
records.biography_en: Nia tunes incident reports for HyperNorm. The unapproved channel is generally the one with the best reception.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: She held up one finger. I heard the official version catch up with us.

records.name: Kel Hindsight
records.biography_en: Kel keeps his working notes visible under glass. HyperNorm sent a cloth to help him achieve discretion.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: The committee admired the dome. Kel had been hoping they'd notice the brain.

records.name: Mara Fallup
records.biography_en: Mara checks that the pieces thrown up by a HyperNorm demolition come down in the authorized order. Some keep their own hours.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: She recovered three pebbles and the principle on which they had been overlooked.

records.name: Pim Loopback
records.biography_en: Pim fitted a pocket portal to the HyperNorm service corridor. An inspection of the other end took less time than deciding which end to inspect.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: I shook his hand twice. He claimed only one arrival.
